title: PCB Editor Capability Report
implemented: Rust schema-v1 PCB routing and validation DTOs

clippy.command: cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p boardforge-geometry -p boardforge-wasm -- -D warnings

limitations: This evidence does not prove a production-quality end-to-end browser editor.
Track shove routing, impedance solving and copper-pour refill are not implemented.
Touch and cross-browser behavior require Playwright proof.
